title: Height Rigidity for Entire Functions
summary: We prove that algebraic values of bounded degree and polynomially bounded height are sparse on rational translates of the graph of a transcendental entire function. More precisely, for fixed $θ\in\overline{\mathbb{Q}}\cap\mathbb{R}$, $D\geq1$, $t>0$, and for every $\varepsilon>0$, only $O(Q^{\varepsilon})$ rationals $r\in[0,1]$ of height at most $Q$ can satisfy simultaneously $[\mathbb{Q}(f(θ+r)):\mathbb{Q}]\leq D$ and $H(f(θ+r))\ll H(r)^t$.
